title: Tiny, cute windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#43a047'/>
  <!-- windmill body (tower) -->
  <path d='M38 84 L42 44 L58 44 L62 84 Z' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <path d='M38 84 L42 44 L46 44 L44 84 Z' fill='#e0cba2'/>
  <!-- roof dome -->
  <path d='M40 44 Q50 28 60 44 Z' fill='#d2694a'/>
  <path d='M40 44 Q45 35 50 33 L50 44 Z' fill='#e8825f'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='46' y='66' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#8d5a2b'/>
  <rect x='47' y='68' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#a86f38'/>
  <!-- little window -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='4' fill='#7ec8e3'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='53' r='1.6' fill='#d6f0fa'/>
  <!-- hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='4' fill='#c9a24a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='2' fill='#f2d980'/>
  <!-- blades: four sails at diagonals -->
  <g>
    <path d='M50 42 L50 10 L58 18 L50 42 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
    <path d='M50 10 L58 18 L50 26 Z' fill='#e8dcb8'/>

    <path d='M82 42 L74 50 L82 58 Z' fill='#e8dcb8'/>
    <path d='M50 42 L50 74 L42 66 L50 42 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
    <path d='M50 74 L42 66 L50 58 Z' fill='#e8dcb8'/>
    <path d='M50 42 L18 42 L26 34 L50 42 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
    <path d='M18 42 L26 34 L18 26 Z' fill='#e8dcb8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- center pin -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='2.6' fill='#e8b84b'/>
  <!-- tiny clouds -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='18' rx='8' ry='4.5' fill='#8fb8e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='16' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#a9ccec'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='24' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8fb8e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='22' rx='5' ry='3.4' fill='#a9ccec'/>
</svg>
